newsitem.title: USA: All American sees Q1 1997 profit.
newsitem.headline: All American sees Q1 1997 profit.

text.p: All American Semiconductor Inc said Thursday that it expects to show a profit for the first quarter of 1997.

The company said unaudited sales for the first quarter of 1997 exceeded $62 million, down slightly from the first quarter of 1996, when sales were about $63 million, excluding $4.2 million of sales from discontinued operations.
The company said its sales and gross profit information remains subject to adjustments in connection with the preparation of Form 10-Q for the first quarter of 1997.
The company issued a statement saying it believes "the worst is behind us now," citing its "aggressive cost control programs."
With the excess plant capacity the company has in place, the company said it should be able to improve productivity and efficiencies in the future, provided that it attains sales growth goals.
